current_release_search: Official travel-surveys catalogue lists 2023 RFI takeaways and the 2010/2011 release; a 2024 procurement document describes a future survey, not a downloaded new release.

person_school_level.interpretation: current attendance, not highest completed education

home_county.warning: PER HFIPS contains decoded county labels, not numeric FIPS

school_trip.duration: TRPDUR in minutes; validate against clock elapsed with floating tolerance
school_trip.avoid: TRPDUR_HN is modeled highway-network time; TTTSS is bicycle-only

weights.trip_adjustment: TOURFAC corrects GPS versus diary under-reporting; do not give multi-trip persons extra population weight

keys.warning: Manual three-field linked key SAMPN/PERNO/LTRIPNO is not unique in released CSV; LTRIPNO resets within tour

order.selection: Order by departure time relative to 03:00 or verified place sequence; do not globally sort LTRIPNO

limitations: Historical release is not 2026 travel evidence
Survey sample and weights do not make a census; sampling uncertainty requires separate treatment
Diary and proxy reporting, edited/imputed records and GPS-correction issues remain
Unknown/nontravel/first school trip from elsewhere must not be silently deleted
School destinations outside NYC may remain valid for NYC resident cohort
Public release coarsens geography; no precise individual location extraction is needed
license_note: Public-use manual retains credits and disclaimer; describes noncommercial use. Original manual is archived alongside original ZIP.

weight_precision_check.trip_weight_factor_identity: WHT_FAC3 approximately HH_WHT2*TOURFAC for all 143925 rows
weight_precision_check.comparison_tolerance: relative1e-7 for cross-file HH_WHT2 formatting; absolute1e-8 minutes for clock duration
